post.summary:
Decides the price paid before for every item at once, at the start of the agreement
(CEO, 2026-11-03: "the price on the last invoice before we start; we decide it for each
item and do not change it later"). Same rule as at reconciliation: the factory's last
purchase record dated before the start date, never one of our own orders; items already
fixed keep their baseline.

indices.description: Positions in the suggestion's `items` array to add to the request.

reset_mfa.description: Remove the authenticator so the person enrols again at next admin sign-in.

unlock.description: Lift a lockout after too many failed sign-ins.

AddMemberResponse.description: Identical for new and existing accounts, so it never reveals whether an email is registered.

step.description: `mfa` (enter the authenticator code) or `enroll` (set up an authenticator first).

token.description: Short-lived token for the next step (5 min for `mfa`, 15 min for `enroll`).

decided_action.description: The action that was executed (the proposal, or the person's edit of it).

proposed_action.description: `{"type": "...", ...}`; executed only after a person approves or edits it.

title_key.description: Locale key (`agents:<lane>.…`); `params` holds the values its text needs.

runs_by_status.description: Runs of the last 30 days by status.

mpn.description: Part number and/or description of the item, as on the factory's request.

note.description: Where the number comes from (e.g. "factory's invoice 2026-03, no. 1234").

unit_price_milli.description: The price the factory paid before, in thousandths of a minor unit.

share_bps.description: Our share of the saving in basis points; default 5000 (half).

alias_key.description: The key written differently (usually the request line's `item_key`).

canonical_key.description:
The key it is the same item as (usually a purchase-history key). When that key is
itself an alias, its canonical key is used.

rfq_id.description: The RFQ, by id or by its number (`RFQ-2026-000001`).

supplier_id.description:
The supplier who sent it (must be asked in the RFQ). When left out, the recipient
whose email domain matches the sender is taken, if exactly one does.

source.description: `history` (the factory's own record before the agreement) or `agreed`.

used.description: Ledger rows that used this baseline; a used baseline can no longer be removed.

ComparisonResult.description: One quotation's evaluation inside a stored comparison run.

oneOf.description:
The decision memo (customer's priorities, risks, evidence). A recommendation for a
person, never a decision; absent in runs stored before it existed.

price_alert_bps.description: The customer's alert line when the comparison ran (`buying_criteria.price_alert_bps`).

price_alerts.description: Lines whose change is above the customer's alert line.

price_checks.description:
Reference only: each quoted line against the customer's last purchase of the item.
Never affects compliance or rank. Empty for readers without purchase-history access.

total_minor.description: In the request currency; absent when it cannot be computed without FX.

currency.description: ISO 4217: JPY, USD, EUR, INR, CNY, KRW.

message.description: Shown to suppliers. Must not contain the customer's identity.

reason.description: Why the amount is returned (printed on the credit note).

price_alert_bps.description: Flag quotes this much above the last price paid (basis points, 1000 = 10 %).

priorities.description:
Most important first; each of `price`, `lead_time`, `quality`, `existing_supplier`,
`domestic` at most once.

unbilled_fee_minor.description: Fees not yet on a Chuo-Sogo invoice.

action.description: For `edit`: the action as changed (same `type` as the proposal).

accepted.description: true: applied to the editor; false: discarded.

DecisionMemo.description:
How one quotation fares against the customer's own criteria (the LAYA method: evidence,
scoring, risk penalties, reasons). Deterministic; uses only this customer's data.

past_purchases.description: Purchases from this supplier in the customer's history.

score.description: 0–1000; null when it cannot be recommended (excluded, not compliant, no comparable total).

confirmed_on.description: The delivery date the supplier confirmed.

org_kind.description: `platform`, `customer`, `supplier` or `consumer`: which app the account belongs in.

role.description: Role code in the account's organisation (translated by the apps).

channel.description:
`test`: messages are only recorded for manual export; `live`: queued and sent by email
or FAX (server configured with `PROCURE_SUPPLIER_MAIL=live`).

used.description: A quotation was recorded from it.

secret.description: Base32 secret to type into an authenticator app.

ErrorBody.description: Every error response. `code` is stable and localised by the client.

detail.description: Machine-readable detail (e.g. which field), never internal error text.

url.description: Public https source. Either a URL or a note is required.

text.description: Untrusted text (customer email, supplier reply). At most 20,000 characters.

fixed.description: Items whose baseline was fixed now.

waiting_for_factory.description: Of those, waiting for a factory approver to confirm them.

waiting_on.description: Suppliers that have not answered yet.

listing_id.description: The listing being edited (none: a new listing).

unit_price_milli.description: Thousandths of a minor currency unit.

currency.description: Currency for rows without one; the organisation's usual currency, default `JPY`.

file_name.description:
`.xlsx`, `.csv` or `.tsv` (UTF-8 or Shift_JIS); a PDF (text layer, else OCR); or a
scanned page / photo / FAX as PNG, JPEG or TIFF (OCR, Japanese and English).

`.csv`, `.tsv` (UTF-8 or Shift_JIS) or `.xlsx`. One row per line; rows with the same
value in the request column (件名 / request) become one request.

created.description: Draft requests created (the requester reviews and submits each one).

source.description: `file`, `ocr` (a scan read by OCR) or `order` (an order completed in this system).

credit_notes.description: Credit notes issued against this invoice (any status, admin only; issued for customers).

pdf_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the issued PDF (hex), also recorded in the audit log.

tax_minor.description: Tax as printed on the invoice.

order_item_id.description:
Omit for something the supplier billed that is not on the order (then `description`
is required); it becomes a discrepancy.

overdue.description: Issued, unpaid and past its due date (Japan time).

issue_date.description: Default: today (Japan time). Not in the future, not before the original invoice.

bank_details.description: Bank transfer details printed on invoices.

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number as the customer knows it.

item_key.description: The line's matching key (`m:` part number / `d:` description); null = nothing to match.

matched_on.description:
`mpn` or `description`: what the past purchases were matched on; `alias` when some came
through an item confirmed as the same; null = nothing to match.

product_identity_id.description: The catalogue record the item was verified against.

unit_price_minor.description: Unit price in minor units, tax excluded.

duplicates.description: Moderation only: other active listings with the same manufacturer and model number.

missing.description: What is still missing before the listing can be submitted (stable codes).

review_note.description: Reviewer's note (reason for a rejection). Not shown in the catalogue.

serial_number.description: Only for individual units (used / refurbished / one-off).

stock.description: Units in stock; empty = on request.

input_text.description:
The text the suggestion was made from (typed, transcribed or read from the file), so
the supplier can check what was heard or read.

allow_domains.description: Email only to these domains (pilot), when not empty.

inbox.description: Replies are read from a mailbox.

live.description: Quote requests are really sent (else only recorded, test mode).

MatchTolerances.description:
Match tolerances. A zero limit is not set; a difference is within tolerance only when it is
within every limit set for its kind. All zero (the default) = exact: nothing is proposed for
acceptance.

currency.description: Currency of the absolute limits (never applied to another currency).

price_bps.description: Unit price difference as a share of the ordered price, in basis points (100 = 1%).

price_line_abs_minor.description: A line's price difference (unit difference × invoiced quantity), minor units.

quantity_bps.description: Quantity difference as a share of the ordered/received quantity, basis points.

rounding_minor.description: Tax difference allowed for rounding, minor units.

kind.description: `photo` (JPEG/PNG/WebP, at least 1200 px on the long side) or `document` (PDF).

access.description: `member` of the organisation, or internal staff `assigned` to serve it.

MemoFactor.description: One factor of the memo's score.

retention.description: What happens to this data when the account is closed.

fee_minor.description: Our share of that potential at the agreed (or default) share.

potential_minor.description: Paid above the factory's own lowest price for the item.

channel.description: `test`, `email` or `fax` once written to the outbox.

status.description:
`draft` (prepared, not yet checked and sent), `recorded` (test mode), `queued`,
`sent` or `failed`.

delivery_confirmed_on.description: The date the supplier confirmed to our staff.

late.description: Not everything has arrived and the expected day has passed (organisation's calendar).

promised_on.description: From the quotation's longest lead time (null when the supplier gave none).

audit_chain_valid.description: Hash chain of the organisation's audit log intact.

ai_enabled.description: Whether AI suggestions may be used for this organisation.

chase_default_hours.description: Hours to collect quotations when an RFQ has no response date.

default_tax_rate_bps.description: Default invoice tax rate in basis points (1000 = 10%).

identify_sla_hours.description: Hours Chuo-Sogo has to identify products after a request is submitted.

status.description: `active` or `suspended` (suspended: nobody can work in it; data is kept).
recorded (test mode), queued, sent or failed.

unit_price_milli.description: Thousandths of a minor currency unit.

paid.description: true: received (needs `paid_on`); false: undo a mistaken payment record.

expected_total_minor.description: The total the consumer saw (tax included); the order is refused if prices changed.

version.description: 0 for the built-in default (one approval, never by the requester).

data_rows.description: Non-blank data rows in the file.

errors.description: The first rows that could not be read.

ocr.description:
Read by OCR: dates, quantities, prices and part numbers must be checked against the
paper; cells the OCR was unsure of are refused (`ocr_unclear`).

sample.description: The first rows as they would be stored.

PriceCheck.description: A quoted line next to the last price the customer paid for the same item.

change_bps.description:
Change against the last price in basis points (+1250 = 12.5 % dearer); null when the
currencies differ (no FX).

last_unit_price_milli.description: Thousandths of a minor unit of `last_currency`.

quoted_unit_price_minor.description: Quoted unit price, in the quotation currency.

auto_send_supplier_mail.description:
Supplier mail from approved actions is sent only when this is on and the server's
live mail is configured; otherwise it stays a test-mode record.

follow_ups.description: Sent RFQs past their response date with suppliers still silent.

tasks.description: Open tasks, overdue first, then by due time.

org_timezone.description: The customer's timezone, for showing due times as the customer counts them.

ai_suggestion_id.description: The AI suggestion the operator started from (marked accepted; values are the operator's).

source_document_id.description: The supplier's file this quotation was read from (`reply-text`), kept as received.

alternative.description: The supplier offers a different product than the verified one.

reason.description: Required when recommending anything other than the top-ranked quotation.

remaining_approvals.description: Approvals still needed while awaiting approval.

checked_at.description: Our staff check of the comparison before the factory sees it (required for sending).

truncated.description: More rows matched than returned (narrow the search).

po_number.description: The customer's own purchase order number.

date.description: Transaction date in the organisation's time zone.

document_id.description: The file the record was read from, kept as received.

reference.description: The counterparty's or the factory's document number.

messages.description: Suppliers reminded (those that have not replied or declined).

file_name.description:
A saved supplier email (`.eml`, attachments read too), a PDF (text layer, else OCR),
an Excel / CSV sheet, or a scanned page / FAX (PNG, JPEG, TIFF; OCR).

supplier_id.description: The supplier who sent it, when known (kept with the file).

document_id.description:
The file, kept unchanged as an electronic transaction record; pass it to the
quotation as `source_document_id`.

text.description: The reply as text, for the operator to read and then pass to quotation extraction.

note.description: Required for a rejection (shown to the supplier); optional otherwise.

documents.description:
Supplier files received for this RFQ (uploaded, or read from the mailbox), kept as
received. Shown to our staff only.

latest_comparison_id.description: Most recent comparison run of this RFQ, if any.

checked_at.description: Our staff check before the RFQ goes out (required for dispatch).

row.description: 1-based row number in the file, as the spreadsheet shows it.

month.description:
The monthly invoice, `YYYY-MM`: fees of orders placed up to the end of that month
(earlier unbilled fees included). Give `month` or `through`.

through.description: Bill fees of orders placed up to and including this day.

checked.description: The sender confirms having read the order against the approved quotation.

contact_email.description: Admin console only: the consumer's email address.

free_shipping_over_minor.description: Free shipping from this items total (tax included); empty = never free.

open.description: Orders are accepted only when open (and the notice below is complete).

payment_days.description: Days to pay after the order is confirmed.

relevant.description: Something says it sells these items (not only a good record).

code.description:
quoted_before, cheapest_before, ordered_before, bought_before, category,
approved_by_factory, replies, no_replies, already_invited.

of.description: For replies: out of how many requests.

status.description: Always `check_email`: the same answer whether or not the address already has an account.

description.description: The most recent purchase of that item, as written then.

score.description: How alike it looks, 0–1000 (part number or description characters).

answer.description: Required when answering a clarification question.

output.description: Validated output: an array of item suggestions, or a quotation suggestion. Null when failed.

fax.description: FAX number (digits, optional leading +), for suppliers that take requests by FAX.

rfq_channel.description: How quote requests go out: `email` (default) or `fax`.

due_date.description: Alternative to `due_at`: end of this day in the customer's timezone.

assignee_id.description: Use `assign_to_me` to take a task; assigning someone else needs AssignWork.

overdue.description: Open and past its due time.

min_minor.description: Threshold in minor units of the policy currency (inclusive).

item_id.description: Attach to one item of the request instead of the whole request.

note.description: Why this record matches the customer's item (optional).

product_id.description: A verified record from Chuo-Sogo's product catalogue (`/api/v1/products`).
